description: Motor Vehicle Registrations, 1900 - 2024 (MV-1) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual state-reported motor vehicle registration data for the 50 states, DC, and Puerto Rico (2000 - 2010) reported in Highway Statistics table MV-1. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 5 columns, among them Category, Type, State, Vehicles, Year. The portal shows 2026-02-11 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
